purpose: Phase-6C population-response profiles per species + cell model. A population profile is available ONLY where Phase-6B single-cell apoptosis evidence exists AND population-level evidence is absent -> the relationship is a LABELLED prediction, never experimental. NOT_REPORTED single-cell contexts stay NOT_REPORTED (idle). No population behaviour transfers silently across cell models.

mouse_b16bl6_population.uncertainty: Population composition is inferred from the single-cell (context-transferred B16 -> B16BL6) apoptosis trajectory; no B16BL6 population-level apoptosis dataset is in the frozen package. Fractions are schematic, not measured.

context_transfer.rationale: The population echo inherits the single-cell B16 -> B16BL6 mechanism transfer used in Phase 6B; the canonical line has no direct population apoptosis dataset.

mouse_b16_population.uncertainty: Single-cell apoptosis mechanism is experimentally grounded in B16, but the frozen package reports NO population-level apoptotic fraction / accounting -> the population composition is a labelled mechanistic prediction, not measured.

mouse_b16f10_population.disease_context: cutaneous melanoma (separate experimental single-cell reference line)
mouse_b16f10_population.uncertainty: B16-F10 single-cell apoptosis mechanism is experimentally grounded (kept separate from B16), but no B16-F10 population-level dataset is reported -> population composition is a labelled mechanistic prediction, not measured.

human_hacat_population.uncertainty: Phase-6B apoptosis is NOT_REPORTED for HaCaT (no single-cell apoptosis evidence), so no population apoptosis relationship is defensible -> population is NOT_REPORTED (idle).

rat_skin_population.disease_context: ex vivo rat skin (transport reference; no cellular apoptosis dataset)
rat_skin_population.uncertainty: No rat cellular apoptosis dataset; Phase-6B apoptosis is NOT_REPORTED -> population is NOT_REPORTED (idle).

context_rules.prediction_only: A population profile is available only when Phase-6B single-cell apoptosis is active for that context AND no population-level dataset exists; the relationship is then a labelled prediction (never experimental).
context_rules.no_silent_transfer: Population behaviour never transfers across cell models without an explicit CONTEXT_TRANSFER_PREDICTION record.
context_rules.not_reported_stays: A NOT_REPORTED single-cell context yields a NOT_REPORTED (idle) population.
